    From path data to an admissible presentation #

    Path data D on Λᵐᵒᵖ whose paths span, which is admissible, and whose vertices and arrows are linearly independent modulo paths of length at least two, define an admissible bound quiver presentation π : kQ → Λ sending e_v ↦ e_v and a ↦ α_a (toPresentation). If D is special biserial, so is the presentation (isSpecialBiserial_of_pathData).
